result.rationale: In EventManager.ts createAllCalendarEvents, the diff loops over event.destinationCalendar; for each destination without credentialId it runs `this.calendarCredentials.filter((c) => c.type === destination.integration)` and creates an event for every matching credential. If two destination calendars share the same integration type and lack credentialId, the same credentials are iterated twice, creating duplicate events on the same calendar — a plausible defect visible directly in the diff's new loop logic.
